Tours & Experiences / The Bahamas

Pedal Paradise Bahamas

A social, electric-assisted party-bike experience exploring downtown Nassau.

Pedal Paradise offers group excursions combining music, local landmarks and food-and-drink stops. The Bahamas tourism authority lists the operator, and the official site describes its Sip & Spin experience. Meeting points, length and itineraries vary by product; confirm directly when booking.
